n_lk4_16.speaker: narrator
n_lk4_16.text: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.

n_j2_1.speaker: narrator
n_j2_1.text: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:

n_j2_2.speaker: narrator
n_j2_2.text: And both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.

n_j2_6.speaker: narrator
n_j2_6.text: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.

n_j2_9.speaker: narrator
n_j2_9.text: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,

n_j2_11.speaker: narrator
n_j2_11.text: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.

n_ps119_105.speaker: narrator
n_ps119_105.text: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

n_prov3_5.speaker: narrator
n_prov3_5.text: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.

n_ps34_8.speaker: narrator
n_ps34_8.text: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.

j_woman.speaker: jesus
j_woman.text: Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.

j_draw.speaker: jesus
j_draw.text: Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast.

m_servants.speaker: mary
m_servants.text: Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.

s_taste.speaker: steward
s_taste.text: And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.

j_invite.speaker: jesus
j_invite.text: Come with me to Cana. There is a wedding, and we are invited.

naomi_ask.speaker: naomi
naomi_ask.text: Child, I dropped my father's scroll near the olive tree. Could you find it for me?

naomi_thanks.speaker: naomi
naomi_thanks.text: Bless you! Keep its words close, child. They will light your road.

sv_brim.speaker: servant
sv_brim.text: They are full, right up to the brim.

g1.speaker: guest
g1.text: Wine? But those jars held only water!

g2.speaker: guestf
g2.text: Taste it! I have never tasted wine so good.
